title: The Last Enemy
summary: In the tranquil aftermath of the 100th chapter celebration, Ha-Jun confronts the final philosophical enemy: the fear of stagnation, choosing to dedicate his eternal power to teaching the next generation.

panels.shot: the quiet campus library at saint mirren on a rainy afternoon
panels.action: Rain softly patters against the cathedral windows of the university library; students study under green brass desk lamps.
panels.prose_en: Rain softly patters against the cathedral windows of the university library; students study under green brass desk lamps.
panels.prose_hi: Vishwavidyalaya pustakalaya ki girjaghar ki khidkiyon par baarish dhire-dhire thapthpati hai; chhatra hare pital ke desk lamp ke neeche adhyayan karte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun sitting at a long mahogany table tutoring young demon and human students
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits between a young horned demon boy and a human girl, patiently explaining mana stabilization math.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Remember, mana density follows the inverse square law. Relax your breathing.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits between a young horned demon boy and a human girl, patiently explaining mana stabilization math.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek yuva seeng wale rakshas ladke aur ek manav ladki ke beech baithta hai, aur dhairyapoorvak man sthirikaran ganit samjhata hai.

panels.shot: the demon boy successfully creating a miniature glowing flower in his palm
panels.action: The young demon boy's eyes widen as a tiny glowing violet rose blossoms harmlessly in his hand: 'I did it, Professor Kang!'

dialogue.speaker: demon_student
dialogue.text: Look! It didn't burn!

panels.prose_en: The young demon boy's eyes widen as a tiny glowing violet rose blossoms harmlessly in his hand: 'I did it, Professor Kang!'.
panels.prose_hi: Yuva danav ladke ki aankhen fail gai aur uske haath mein ek chhota chamakta hua baingani gulab hanirahit roop se khil gaya: 'maine yah kiya, professor cong!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly ruffling the boy's hair
panels.action: Ha-Jun ruffles his hair: 'Told you. Power is like water. If you fight it, it splashes. If you guide it, it flows.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bohot achha kiya. Proud of you.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun ruffles his hair: 'Told you. Power is like water. If you fight it, it splashes. If you guide it, it flows.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apne bal udhede: 'tumhen bataya tha. shakti pani ki tarah hai. yadi aap usse ladte han, to wah chhinte maarta hai. yadi aap iska margdarshan karte han, to yah bahti hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun leaning against the bookshelf watching with folded arms
panels.action: Tae-Jun watches from the stacks, holding an armful of historical textbooks, his eyes full of warmth.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: You're a natural teacher, Ha-Jun. You have Dad's patience.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun watches from the stacks, holding an armful of historical textbooks, his eyes full of warmth.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun mutthi bhar aitihasik paathyapustaken haath mein liye dher se dekhta hai, uski aankhen garmjoshi se bhari han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at tae-jun with an affectionate smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles: 'Dad was the best teacher in the world. I'm just copying him.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Dad se hi seekha hai sab.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles: 'Dad was the best teacher in the world. I'm just copying him.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun muskurata hai: 'pitaji duniya ke sabse acche shikshak the. main bus uski nakal kar raha hun.'

panels.shot: kuro napping inside a hollowed-out dictionary on the bookshelf
panels.action: Kuro naps comfortably inside a large open copy of the Oxford English Dictionary, his wing draped over 'Peace'.
panels.prose_en: Kuro naps comfortably inside a large open copy of the Oxford English Dictionary, his wing draped over 'Peace'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro oxford english dictionary ki ek badi khuli prati ke andar aaram se jhapki le raha hai, uska pankh 'pis' par lipta hua hai.

panels.shot: min-jae walking into the library carrying two warm cardboard coffee trays
panels.action: Min-Jae enters quietly on tiptoes, balancing four cups of warm hazelnut lattes: 'Coffee break for the faculty!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Shh! Librarian is watching! Grab your latte!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae enters quietly on tiptoes, balancing four cups of warm hazelnut lattes: 'Coffee break for the faculty!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je char cup garm hezalant latte ko santulit karte hue chupchap panjon ke bal pravesh karta hai: 'faculti ke liye coffee brek!'.

panels.shot: the four companions whispering and laughing behind the history bookshelves
panels.action: The four friends huddle behind the bookshelf, sipping warm lattes and giggling like high schoolers.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, you're the Dean of Administration and you're sneaking food in the library?

panels.prose_en: The four friends huddle behind the bookshelf, sipping warm lattes and giggling like high schoolers.
panels.prose_hi: Charon dost bukashelf ke peeche chhupe hue han, garm latte pee rahe hain aur high school ke chhatron ki tarah khilkhila rahe han.

panels.shot: min-jae winking playfully: 'perks of having sovereign immunity!'
panels.action: Min-Jae winks: 'If the head librarian complains, I'll tell her the Demon Sovereign ordered the coffee!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Sovereign privilege!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae winks: 'If the head librarian complains, I'll tell her the Demon Sovereign ordered the coffee!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je aankh maarte hue kahte han: 'agar head librarian shikayat karta hai, to main use bataunga ki demon sovereign ne coffee ka order diya tha!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking his head laughing softly
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs, taking a warm sip, feeling the deep, cozy simplicity of everyday human happiness.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs, taking a warm sip, feeling the deep, cozy simplicity of everyday human happiness.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hansta hai, ek garm ghunt peeta hai, rojmarra ki manviya khushi ki gahri, aaramdayak sadgi ko mahsoos karta hai.

panels.shot: the rain outside tapering off into a misty golden afternoon drizzle
panels.action: The heavy rain outside softens into a misty shower; sunlight breaks through the clouds, casting rainbow arcs.
panels.prose_en: The heavy rain outside softens into a misty shower; sunlight breaks through the clouds, casting rainbow arcs.
panels.prose_hi: Bahar bhari baarish dhundhli bauchhar mein badal jaati hai; suraj ki roshni baadalon se hokar gujarti hai aur indradhanushi chaap banati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking over to the cathedral window looking out at the campus lawn
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks out at the green lawns where students are sitting on park benches reading.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks out at the green lawns where students are sitting on park benches reading.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hare lawn ko dekhta hai jahan chhatra park ki benchon par baithe padh rahe han.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up beside him leaning against the stone sill
panels.action: Tae-Jun joins him: 'Do you ever miss the adrenaline, Ha-Jun? The roaring battles?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Jung ki aadat toh nahi pad gayi thi?

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun joins him: 'Do you ever miss the adrenaline, Ha-Jun? The roaring battles?'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun usse judta hai: 'kya tumhe kabhi adrenaline ki yaad aati hai, ha-jun? dahadti ladaiyan?'

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking his head without a single second of doubt
panels.action: Ha-Jun shakes his head firmly: 'Never. The sword was only a tool to reach this silence.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jung sirf is shanti tak pahunchne ka raasta thi. I love this peace.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shakes his head firmly: 'Never. The sword was only a tool to reach this silence.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dridhta se apna sir hilata hai: 'kabhi nahin. talwar is maun tak pahunchne ka ek sadhan matra thi.'

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto the sill pecking at a raindrop on the glass
panels.action: Kuro taps the glass: 'A warrior who loves fighting is a butcher. A warrior who loves peace is a King.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: That is why Asmodaius yielded his crown to you.

panels.prose_en: Kuro taps the glass: 'A warrior who loves fighting is a butcher. A warrior who loves peace is a King.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne kaanch thapthpaya: 'jo yoddha ladna pasand karta hai wah kasai hota hai. ek yoddha jo shanti pasand karta hai wah ek raja hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling scratching kuro neck with gentle fingertips
panels.action: Ha-Jun scratches under Kuro's beak: 'You always say the right things when you're not eating my croissants.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kabhi kabhi bohot samajhdar baatein karte ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun scratches under Kuro's beak: 'You always say the right things when you're not eating my croissants.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kuro ki chonch ke neeche kharonchta hai: 'jab aap mere croisain nahin kha rahe hote hain to aap hamesha sahi baatein kahte han.'

panels.shot: the library bell chiming five in the afternoon: classes ending
panels.action: The antique grandfather clock in the corner chimes five melodious tones; students begin packing bags.
panels.prose_en: The antique grandfather clock in the corner chimes five melodious tones; students begin packing bags.
panels.prose_hi: Kone mein lagi prachin dadaji ki ghadi paanch madhur swar bajati hai; chhatra bag pack karna shuru karte han.

panels.shot: the young demon and human students waving to ha-jun as they leave
panels.action: The students bow politely: 'Thank you, Professor Ha-Jun! See you on Wednesday!'

dialogue.speaker: students
dialogue.text: Thank you, Professor!

panels.prose_en: The students bow politely: 'Thank you, Professor Ha-Jun! See you on Wednesday!'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhatra vinamrata se jhukte han: 'dhanyavad, professor ha-jun! budhwar ko milte han!'

panels.shot: ha-jun waving back warmly: 'do your practice problems, don't slack off!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun waves back: 'Practice your mana circles! I will be checking on Wednesday!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Practice zaroor karna!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun waves back: 'Practice your mana circles! I will be checking on Wednesday!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne jawab diya: 'apne man vritton ka abhyas karen! main budhwar ko janch karunga!'

panels.shot: the library growing quiet as evening golden light floods the stacks
panels.action: The library empties; long amber sunbeams illuminate the polished oak floors and dusty book bindings.
panels.prose_en: The library empties; long amber sunbeams illuminate the polished oak floors and dusty book bindings.
panels.prose_hi: Pustkalay khali ho jata hai; lambi amber dhoop ki kiranen polish kiye gaye oak farsh aur dhul bhari kitabon ki binding ko roshan karti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun, tae-jun, and min-jae packing their satchels together
panels.action: The three young men zip their leather bags, ready to head home for the evening.
panels.prose_en: The three young men zip their leather bags, ready to head home for the evening.
panels.prose_hi: Teenon yuvak apne chamde ke bag band kar sham ke liye ghar jaane ke liye taiyar han.

panels.shot: tae-jun checking the grocery list on his phone
panels.action: Tae-Jun scrolls on his phone: 'We need green onions, tofu, and beef brisket for the sundubu stew.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Supermarket chalte hain. Dinner banana hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun scrolls on his phone: 'We need green onions, tofu, and beef brisket for the sundubu stew.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apne phone par scroll karta hai: 'hamen sundubu stu ke liye hari pyaj, tofu aur beef brisket ki aavashyakta hai.'

panels.shot: min-jae inviting himself over with zero shame
panels.action: Min-Jae grins: 'Sundubu stew?! Count me in! I'll buy the ice cream for dessert!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: I'm coming over for dinner!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae grins: 'Sundubu stew?! Count me in! I'll buy the ice cream for dessert!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je muskurati hai: 'sundubu stu?! apni gatividhi ya yojana mein mujhe shamil karen! main mithai ke liye icecream khridunga!'

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing putting his arm around min-jae shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs: 'You eat dinner at our place six days a week, Min-Jae. You practically live with us.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhara apna ghar nahi hai kya?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs: 'You eat dinner at our place six days a week, Min-Jae. You practically live with us.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hanste hue kahte han: 'aap saptah mein chhah din hamare yahan khana khate han, min-je. aap vyavharik roop se hamare saath rahte han.'

panels.shot: min-jae beaming: 'your brother cooks ten times better than my microwave!'
panels.action: Min-Jae shrugs proudly: 'Tae-Jun hyung's cooking is an S-rank national treasure!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung ka khana Michelin star level hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae shrugs proudly: 'Tae-Jun hyung's cooking is an S-rank national treasure!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je garv se kandhe uchkaate han: 'taaye-jun hyung ka khana banana ek s-rank rashtriya khajana hai!'

panels.shot: tae-jun puffing his chest proudly: 'at least someone appreciates my culinary genius'
panels.action: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'See? Min-Jae has taste. Unlike my ungrateful little brother.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae ko asli taste ki samajh hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'See? Min-Jae has taste. Unlike my ungrateful little brother.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun hanste hue kahte han: 'dekha? min-je mein swad hai. mere kritghan chhote bhai ke viparit.'

panels.shot: the group walking down the grand marble staircase of the library
panels.action: The four friends walk down the marble stairs, their laughter echoing through the quiet halls.
panels.prose_en: The four friends walk down the marble stairs, their laughter echoing through the quiet halls.
panels.prose_hi: Charon dost sangmarmar ki sidhiyon se neeche chalte han, unki hansi shant hall mein goonjati hai.

panels.shot: stepping out into the fresh, rain-scented autumn evening breeze
panels.action: They step out of the heavy glass doors into the cool, rain-washed evening air, streetlamps buzzing to life.
panels.prose_en: They step out of the heavy glass doors into the cool, rain-washed evening air, streetlamps buzzing to life.
panels.prose_hi: Ve bhari sheeshe ke darwazon se bahar nikal kar baarish se dhuli sham ki thandi hawa mein kadam rakhte han, street lamp jeevant ho uthte han.

panels.shot: the three friends walking shoulder to shoulder into the sunset cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro walk down the tree-lined street together into the golden sunset glow!

dialogue.text: DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — CHAPTER 101 CONCLUDED.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro walk down the tree-lined street together into the golden sunset glow!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun, taaye-jun, min-je, aur kuro suryast ki sunhari chamak mein pedon se ghiri sadak par ek saath chalte han!
